    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); out=[r[:] for r in grid]

def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    # A colored border segment marks the axis for projecting isolated clue cells.
    # Project each clue along the axis perpendicular to the border segment; clues become 4.
    bg=max(set(x for row in grid for x in row),key=lambda x:sum(row.count(x) for row in grid))
    top=[c for c,x in enumerate(grid[0]) if x!=bg]
    bottom=[c for c,x in enumerate(grid[-1]) if x!=bg]
    left=[r for r in range(h) if grid[r][0]!=bg]
    right=[r for r in range(h) if grid[r][-1]!=bg]
    vertical=bool(top or bottom)
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            x=grid[r][c]
            if x==bg or (r in (0,h-1) or c in (0,w-1) and x in (grid[0][0],grid[-1][-1])): continue
            # Any interior non-background mark is a clue; project it across its row/column.
            if vertical:
                out[r][c]=4
                for rr in range(h):
                    if grid[rr][c]==bg: out[rr][c]=x
            else:
                out[r][c]=4
                for cc in range(w):
                    if grid[r][cc]==bg: out[r][cc]=x
    # Preserve all boundary stripes.
    for c in range(w): out[0][c]=grid[0][c]; out[h-1][c]=grid[h-1][c]
    for r in range(h): out[r][0]=grid[r][0]; out[r][w-1]=grid[r][w-1]
    return out
PY
